item.title: Why Is My Gas Bill So High? 10 Common Causes and How to Fix Each One
item.description:
A high gas bill usually comes down to one of three things: you’re using more gas than usual, your equipment is wasting gas, or your rate went up. This guide helps you figure out which one — and what to do about it. Learn more in MCF vs CCF vs Therms.

Natural gas bills are measured in therms (1 therm = 100,000 BTU) or CCF (hundred cubic feet). One CCF ≈ 1.037 therms. For most households, the difference is negligible — but knowing your units helps when comparing bills. Learn more in Gas Customer Charge Explained.
